entry_points.name: Team QA board commands
entry_points.description: Operators initialize, validate, render, apply, synchronize and open an explicit canonical board path.

entry_points.name: Native board delta
entry_points.description: A doc-colab staging packet requests status, priority, assignee and comment changes.

entry_points.name: Notion adapter environment
entry_points.description: Explicit command arrays provide probe, push and readback operations for opt-in remote sync.

entry_points.name: Release B reliability handoff
entry_points.description: A verified Team QA receipt and an immutable Team-code Job Capsule produce one exact case-bound envelope.

trust_boundaries.name: Team QA to qa-gui
trust_boundaries.description: Canonical validation and mutation remain owned by the external qa-gui child gate.

trust_boundaries.name: Team QA to doc-colab
trust_boundaries.description: Rendering remains owned by the external native renderer and requires canonical readback equality.

trust_boundaries.name: Canonical source to Notion
trust_boundaries.description: Remote rows are untrusted until an explicit opt-in operation and full readback comparison succeed.

trust_boundaries.name: Team QA producer to Team-code consumer
trust_boundaries.description: Receipt bytes, exact SHA, requirements hash and capsule digest are untrusted until contract and integrity readback pass.

sensitive_assets.name: Canonical QA board
sensitive_assets.description: The source file and revision are the only authority for cases, defects, evidence and release state.

sensitive_assets.name: QA role transitions
sensitive_assets.description: VERIFIED and CLOSED ownership must be enforced by qa-gui rather than duplicated in Team QA.

sensitive_assets.name: Independent audit evidence
sensitive_assets.description: SCROLL ledger and gate receipts remain outside the canonical board payload.

sensitive_assets.name: Handoff and acknowledgement bindings
sensitive_assets.description: Run UUID, task base, source revision, final SHA, requirements and capsule digest must remain exact and sealed.

high_impact_sinks.name: Child process execution
high_impact_sinks.description: Every external child must be explicit, bounded and fail-closed on status, signal or malformed output.

high_impact_sinks.name: Canonical board write
high_impact_sinks.description: A mutation is confirmed only after qa-gui validation and independent readback.

high_impact_sinks.name: Notion push
high_impact_sinks.description: Remote sync requires renderer opt-in, successful probe, push, readback and zero mismatches.

high_impact_sinks.name: Reliability handoff write
high_impact_sinks.description: The envelope is written only after receipt and Job Capsule verification; the Team-code acknowledgement must be independently verified.
